fusions.name: Worry the Wound
fusions.desc: Bites into a wound and shakes, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Hold the Point
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly-Low Stalk
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Steady to Wing
fusions.desc: A bonded pointer fights beside you, biting enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Its bite leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
